name: Cap's Tavern
description: Cap's is a vibrant karaoke bar renowned for its lively Friday night karaoke sessions from 8 pm to Midnight, featuring a wide range of genres and a friendly, energetic crowd. The venue boasts a new, clean building with a great sound system and an inviting atmosphere that makes everyone feel welcome. Whether you're a seasoned singer or just looking to have fun, Cap's offers a memorable experience with excellent service and a community vibe that keeps patrons coming back.
